entry.question_description: A string can have a free end if that end is attached to a ring that can slide without friction on a vertical pole (figure).
entry.question_description_simplified: A string can have a free end if that end is attached to a ring that can slide without friction on a vertical pole.
entry.image_caption: The image depicts a diagram featuring a rod and a cylindrical pole. The rod is labeled with two points: a "Fixed end" on the left and a "Free end" on the right. The rod is curved and extends from the fixed end to the free end, passing through a ring on the pole. The pole appears to be vertical, and a length symbol "\(\ell\)" is shown between the fixed end and the pole, indicating the distance covered by the rod.
